Hey everybody, I'm happy to share out fifth macOS app - CoolDock. CoolDock is all about bringing the most useful widgets to you, without taking more space on your screen. It includes more than 160 widgets, 3rd party integrations, reminders like posture and drink, and a premium library of 170 premium wallpapers included in the app from a collaboration with another developer. The app won awards for both design and UI/UX, on the website you can find the roadmap and recent updates, feedback and upvotes on tickets in the roadmap dictate where we'll take the app, and our users absolutely love it!
